columns.name: jurisdictions
columns.description: Jurisdictions with at least one national tariff line under this HS6: us, eu, ca, au.

columns.name: jurisdictions_count
columns.description: Number of jurisdictions present (1 to 4); the UK is not counted.

columns.name: us_codes
columns.description: US HTS lines: code, description, general_rate. Null when absent.

columns.name: eu_codes
columns.description: EU TARIC 10-digit codes: code, description (always null, not in the source), general_rate (third-country duty as published, with dates when several periods). Null when absent.

columns.name: ca_codes
columns.description: Canada Customs Tariff items: code, statistical_suffix, description, general_rate (MFN). Null when absent.

columns.name: au_codes
columns.description: Australia Working Tariff codes: code, statistical_code, description, general_rate. Null when absent.

columns.name: uk_quota_codes
columns.description: Informational, not counted: UK commodity codes covered by a tariff quota under this HS6 (code, quota_order_numbers). Null when none.
